    Export a Cubert measurement to a portable ENVI cube

    Source: R/backend-cuvis.R
    at_cubert_export_envi.Rd

    The portable fallback for Cubert data: the CUVIS SDK itself writes an ENVI export, which hyperannotatR (and tools without the SDK) can then read through the envi backend. Requires cuvis.r and a usable CUVIS SDK.

    Usage

    at_cubert_export_envi(path, dir, measurement = 1L, call = rlang::caller_env())

    Arguments

    path

    Path to a .cu3s session file.

    dir

    Output directory for the SDK's ENVI export (created if needed).

    measurement

    1-based measurement index within the session.

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    The files written into dir (character), invisibly.

    See also

    Other backends: at_backend_detect(), at_backend_get(), at_backend_list(), at_backend_register(), at_close_image(), at_image_capabilities(), at_read_image(), at_tile(), at_tivita_profile()

    Other hsi: at_band_operations(), at_band_view(), at_convert_values(), at_hsi_meta(), at_read_stats(), at_tivita_profile()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
at_cubert_export_envi("measurement.cu3s", tempfile("envi-"))
} # }
